build_VoxelGraspGenerator: build a python module using VoxelGraspGenerator to generate top-down grasps from a point cloud and segmentation map
create_compute_grasp_scores: create a function that computes x and y grasp scores from an occupancy map and center point
create_filter_grasps: create a function that filters a 2D grasp score map by neighboring scores and threshold
create_generate_grasp: create a function that generates a 4x4 vertical grasp pose matrix from xyz position and z rotation
create_visualize_grasps: create a function that visualizes 3D point cloud with highlighted points and grasp pose arrows
